world.title: U.S., China, Russia hold historic summit in Shenzhen
world.summary: The leaders of the United States, China, and Russia convened a historic trilateral summit in Shenzhen on November 19, 2026. They emphasized commitments to dialogue, nuclear risk reduction, and global security cooperation. Despite the significant meeting, no substantial resolutions were reached regarding ongoing issues such as the war in Ukraine or the crisis in Iran.

world.title: Xi-Trump-Putin trilateral meeting highlights: Xi-Trump-Putin summit in China ends; major powers must not touch each other's bottom lines on sensitive issues, says Xi
world.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping, U.S. President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin concluded a trilateral summit in China on November 19, 2026. Xi emphasized the importance of respecting each other's boundaries on sensitive issues. Trump remarked that the meeting was historic. The discussions were held behind closed doors, focusing on cooperation among the three major powers.

world.title: Cummins could struggle to captain without refuting Bancroft: Ian Healy
world.summary: Ian Healy has stated that Cameron Bancroft's recent revelations about the Sandpapergate scandal could undermine Pat Cummins' authority as Test captain. He emphasized that Cummins must address Bancroft's claims directly to maintain his leadership credibility. Meanwhile, Sayers commended Bancroft for his bravery in sharing his story in The West Australian, expressing hope that he had spoken out earlier.

business.title: Gold Price Forecast: Falling Stocks Fail to Lift Gold as Dollar Rises
business.summary: Gold prices remain under pressure, trading below $3,800 as the US dollar strengthens and Treasury yields show no signs of correction. The Dow-to-gold ratio's rebound highlights the $3,500–$3,600 support zone. Currently, gold has reached its lowest levels since September 2025, reflecting ongoing challenges in the market despite falling stock prices.

business.title: India Has A New Most Valuable Brand, And It Isn't HDFC Bank. Kantar 2026 Report Lists Top 10
business.summary: Airtel has surpassed HDFC Bank to become India's most valuable brand for the first time, according to the Kantar BrandZ India 2026 report. Airtel's brand value increased by 5% to $43.2 billion, while the overall value of the country's top 100 brands has declined. This marks a significant shift in the rankings of India's leading brands.

business.title: Who is Yash Patil? The 23-year-old Stanford dropout who sold his AI startup to Palo Alto Networks for $4.5 billion
business.summary: Yash Patil, a 23-year-old Indian-American entrepreneur, recently sold his AI startup Applied Compute to Palo Alto Networks for $4.5 billion. Following the acquisition, he will serve as co-chief AI officer at Palo Alto Networks, alongside his team. Earlier in November, Applied Compute raised $350 million at a $3.25 billion valuation, achieving a $100 million annualized revenue run rate.

technology.title: Latest versions and sizes
technology.summary: Rockstar Games has released two updates for Grand Theft Auto VI, enhancing the open-world experience. The updates include specific version numbers and download sizes, along with detailed patch notes. Players can find comprehensive information about the latest improvements and changes made to the game. These updates aim to refine gameplay and address any existing issues within GTA 6.

technology.title: TikToker’s Wife Says GTA VI Is Cheating Because He’d ‘Have a Girlfriend in the Game’
technology.summary: A TikTok video by creator @itsme_mcmuffin, posted on November 14, 2026, features a discussion with his wife about playing GTA VI. She argues that playing the game would be considered cheating because he would have a girlfriend in it. The video, which may be a skit, has garnered over 131,700 views, sparking interest online.

technology.title: Digital Releases as GTA 6 Arrives Without a Disc — BigGo Finance
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI launched as a download-only release, marking a significant shift in the gaming industry. GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen criticized publishers for diminishing consumer rights by moving away from physical discs. This transition has negatively impacted GameStop's business, highlighting concerns over the future of physical media in gaming as digital downloads become increasingly prevalent.

sports.title: Sri Lanka fight, but Pakistan primed for victory despite Day 3 toil
sports.summary: Sri Lanka showed resilience on Day 3 of the second Test against Pakistan in Rawalpindi, with fifties from Kusal Mendis and Sonal Dinusha helping them take a lead. Despite their efforts, Pakistan claimed crucial late wickets, maintaining pressure. Sri Lanka's second innings extended into the fourth day, highlighting the competitive nature of the match as both teams fought for victory.

sports.title: Pochettino: Man United players must relearn to be 'winners'
sports.summary: Mauricio Pochettino, the new head coach of Manchester United, stated that his primary task is to teach the players how to win following a disappointing start to the season. He officially began his role at Carrington after succeeding Michael Carrick. Pochettino aims to instill a winning mentality in the team to improve their performance moving forward.

sports.title: 'Pakistan used bottle tops, not sandpaper': Shoaib Akhtar asks people to stop 'making fuss' over Khawaja's claims
sports.summary: Shoaib Akhtar addressed renewed ball-tampering allegations from Usman Khawaja's autobiography regarding the 2018 Australian cricket scandal. Khawaja suggested that Pakistan's players used sandpaper, but Akhtar countered that they employed bottle tops instead. He urged the public to stop overreacting to the claims, emphasizing that the controversy should not overshadow the sport. The discussion reignites debates about integrity in cricket.

health.title: Understanding patterns of multimorbidity
health.summary: A study revealed that nearly half of patients with multiple long-term conditions in England's most deprived areas faced unplanned hospital admissions within a year. Researchers identified varying patterns of multimorbidity across different ethnic and socioeconomic groups, highlighting significant disparities in health outcomes. The findings underscore the need for targeted healthcare interventions to address these inequalities in multimorbidity management.

health.title: Neurologist explains why quality sleep is vital for brain health and how power naps can help
health.summary: A neurologist emphasizes the importance of quality sleep for brain and body health, noting that sleep cycles play a crucial role in overall well-being. The article discusses how inadequate sleep is often sacrificed for work and social commitments. Additionally, it explores the potential benefits of short power naps in enhancing focus and cognitive function during the day.

health.title: India to Launch First Indigenous H5N1 Bird Flu Vaccine on 20 November
health.summary: India will launch its first indigenous inactivated vaccine against Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) H5N1, Clade 2.3.2.1a, for chickens on 20 November 2026. The vaccine has been developed by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (ICAR-NIHSAD). This initiative aims to enhance poultry health and control the spread of avian influenza.

science.title: Five Near-Earth Asteroids to pass past Earth over 48 hours
science.summary: Five near-Earth asteroids, measuring between 10 and 120 metres, will safely pass by Earth from November 19 to 20. Astronomers are monitoring their trajectories to gather insights for planetary defense. The flybys are part of ongoing efforts to track near-Earth objects and assess potential risks, although none of the asteroids are expected to pose a threat to the planet.

science.title: Not all black holes are born in supernovas. Some stars implode
science.summary: Astronomers from the California Institute of Technology have discovered that many black holes may form from massive stars collapsing inward, rather than through supernova explosions. This finding suggests an alternative formation process for black holes, expanding the understanding of their origins in the universe. The research highlights the complexity of stellar evolution and the mechanisms behind black hole creation.

science.title: Giant Asteroid To Make Close Yet Safe Approach To Earth In August 2027
science.summary: Asteroid 1999 AN10, measuring between 0.5 and 1.1 miles (800 to 1,800 meters) in diameter, will make a close approach to Earth on August 7, 2027. It is expected to pass at a distance similar to that between Earth and the Moon. This Apollo-class asteroid orbits the Sun every 1.76 years and is closely monitored by astronomers.

entertainment.title: "Where Do You See Discomfort?": Keerthy Suresh Clarifies Viral Mysskin Video, User Says Sorry
entertainment.summary: A viral video showed director Mysskin praising actress Keerthy Suresh while briefly touching her near her lap during a speech. Following public reaction, Suresh addressed the situation, asking where the discomfort was perceived. She is currently promoting her film "Sathyavan Savithiri," after the release of "Akka." The incident occurred during a press conference in Chennai.

entertainment.title: Kapil Sharma Gets Romantic
entertainment.summary: Kapil Sharma celebrated his wife Ginni Chatrath's birthday on November 18 by taking their family on a holiday. He shared romantic pictures from the trip, showcasing a more sentimental side of the comedian. The couple's special day was marked by love and family time, contrasting with Sharma's usual comedic persona, highlighting the importance of personal moments in his life.

entertainment.title: Priyanka Chopra, Nick Jonas' daughter Malti Marie recites 'gayatri mantra' in new video, the actress says, netizens say, 'Mommy is raising you beautifully'
entertainment.summary: Priyanka Chopra shared a new Instagram post showcasing her life as a mother, featuring photos and videos from recent days. A notable clip shows her daughter, Malti Marie, reciting the 'Gayatri Mantra.' The post has garnered positive reactions from netizens, with many praising Chopra's parenting and expressing admiration for how she is raising her daughter beautifully.
